'''Blue Two''' was the call-sign for a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] who served the [[Fel Empire]] and the [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]] in [[139 ABY]]. He was loyal to [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Empress]] [[Marasiah Fel]] and wore an orange [[Pauldron/Legends|pauldron]] on his [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]]. Blue Two was part of a platoon sent to accompany [[Ania Solo]], who was tasked by Empress Fel with leading a mission rescue [[Jao Assam]], who had been kidnapped by the rogue [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Darth Wredd]]. Despite Ania's orders that her troopers not make any offworld communications following their landing on the floating world of [[Mala (planet)|Mala]], Blue Two secretly sent Mala's coordinates to Empress Fel, who dispatched a force of [[Imperial Knight]]s to hunt down Darth Wredd.

His absence was noticed by Ania's [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] friend [[Sauk]] who subsequently accused him of leading the [[One Sith]] to them during the [[Battle of the Floating World]]. However, Blue Two vehemently denied working for the One Sith and took great pains to stress his loyalty to Empress Fel. Blue Two's story was supported by Darth Wredd, who revealed that his sloppiness with rescuing Jao Assam had led the One Sith to Mala. Blue Two's fate is unknown during the battle, which ended with the apparent destruction of the One Sith and Darth Wredd's death.
